compute_nvemd_te_drift: compute the total energy drift from an NVE molecular dynamics trajectory file using get_te_drift
calculate_moving_average: calculate a moving average of a numpy array with a configurable window size using moving_avg
join_nvemd_results: join NVE MD drift results from multiple trajectory files in a directory using NVEMDReducer.join_results
compute_nvemd_metrics: compute mean drift metrics in meV/atom/ps from NVE MD results using NVEMDReducer.compute_metrics
save_nvemd_results: save NVE MD drift results and metrics to text and JSON files using NVEMDReducer.save_results and save_metrics
